92dfb5aa964934ed2a1f119b26cf7839318776b6: Corrençon-en-Vercors offers 125 km of well-marked runs, an intermediate-sized ski area that is ideal for spending 4 to 5 days without ever doing exactly the same thing twice. The 21 lifts are generally enough to handle the flow during peak season. Corrençon-en-Vercors has earned its family reputation: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for learning to ski with children. The altitude of Corrençon-en-Vercors (1111 m at the base, 2050 m at the top) helps it maintain decent snow cover through the middle of winter. January and February are the most reliable months; in December and March, it is worth checking conditions before finalising a booking. The day lift pass at 46€ places Corrençon-en-Vercors among the intermediate resorts on budget: neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and its facilities justifies the price for most skiers. In short, Corrençon-en-Vercors is one of those rare resorts that combines a genuine village, a sincerely family-friendly atmosphere and runs suited to everyone. It is hard to have a bad stay here.
